name: Bilyoner
verdict: Turkish online sports-betting platform under Hitay Holding (with Intralot as partner). Private owners, no state stake found, no human-rights finding against the company. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: official sponsor of Anadolu Efes S.K. since 2019-20, renewed for 2026-27 (eighth season). Owned via Hitay Holding (bilyoner-hitay-holding-ownership); Bilyoner's About page also names Intralot as a partner in its partnership structure, but no equity split is given. Gambling brand, so the owner chain was checked for state links: Hitay Holding is private, and no state or state fund is named.
